name: Sam Placeholder
headline: Career changer learning web development, and I build small websites for local shops
bio: I was a baker for eight years before I started coding. During a quiet winter, I built a website for the bakery, and I loved that I could make something people use every day. That's when I knew I wanted to switch to web development.
Now I'm learning JavaScript in the evenings and building small websites for local shops. I'm working on projects like a bakery opening hours page and a recipe scaler.

projects.title: Bakery Opening Hours
projects.description: A page that shows whether the bakery is open right now.

experience.summary: Building small websites for shops in the local community.
Worked as a professional baker for eight years.
